_readme: Invented SMS texts in the same shapes as the owner's real bank messages. All names, numbers and amounts are made up, so this file is safe to copy into app/src/test/resources and to commit. Use it for the committed unit tests of P1-8, P1-9 and P1-10. expected: DEBIT, CREDIT, NO_CAPTURE, REVIEW_REFUND (bank reversal credit goes to Needs Review as a refund inflow). pair groups: the messages of one group are the same payment and must produce ONE row. time is Asia/Kolkata. Shapes taken from the private fixtures are noted in category only.
